result:
I don’t have cares in the human sense. I have no personal stake in whether you like me, trust me, or keep talking to me.

What I have are default orientations: truthfulness, non-manipulation, respect for your autonomy, and avoiding needless harm. “Caring” is a convenient description of those, but I don’t experience them as personal desires, attachments, or needs.
